body.prompt: A 60 second orchestral piece at exactly 100 beats per minute in 4/4 for a film of a snow globe that passes through four seasons, in five sections of exactly 12 seconds (five bars) each, with one short simple melody that passes through all five sections in each season's own instruments. Section 1, winter: warm orchestral Christmas, sleigh bells, celesta, soft wordless choir pads, low strings. Section 2, spring: light and airy, harp, flute, plucked strings. Section 3, summer: warm and unhurried, nylon guitar, soft marimba, a golden dusk. Section 4, fall: Halloween, a detuned music box and piano over low strings, with eerie sounds in the music itself. Section 5, winter again: the winter music returning fuller, sleigh bells, celesta, full strings, resolving on its last bar. The last bar of each of the first four sections thins out and builds into the downbeat of the next, instrumental, no vocals, no spoken words, clean ending
